Round-1 finding 1 is fixed: `compute()` now checks whether Closed exists before checking Close Date, so the combined case reports `status_absent`. Finding 2 remains: `require_area_columns()` exists but is never called by `filter_area()` or any production orchestration. With a configured school filter and an export lacking that column, filtering silently returns no matches instead of raising the required `ClientError`; the added tests only pass because their test helper calls validation explicitly. Smallest fix: invoke area-column validation from the production filtering/orchestration path while preserving the public signatures. Finding 3 is fixed: metrics.py is now 266 lines after extraction to metric_base.py. No generated files are present.
